summary: Review-required audit trail for the live Prefetch cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and the repo cleanup docs describe the same Prefetch directory, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Prefetch Files
setting.casual_explanation: This clears Windows Prefetch files from the Prefetch directory.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear Prefetch files when they are troubleshooting cache state or reclaiming disk space from the Prefetch directory.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Clearing Prefetch files removes the current cache set, and Windows may regenerate them later.
setting.professional_notes: The current app deletes %WINDIR%\Prefetch through FileCleanupTweak. Repo cleanup docs identify the same directory and note that the files can be regenerated over time.

allowed_values.label: No cleanup action
allowed_values.meaning: Prefetch files remain until the operator or Windows removes them.

allowed_values.label: Clear Prefetch files
allowed_values.meaning: Deletes the Prefetch directory contents tracked by the current app.

targets.notes: This is a one-shot cleanup action rather than a persistent Prefetch policy setting.

app_current_implementation.notes: The live app still ships this as a first-party cleanup card instead of through the research-provider surface.

windows_defaults.label: Windows-managed Prefetch baseline
windows_defaults.applies_to: Systems where Prefetch files remain available until they are manually cleared or regenerated by Windows

states.rationale: This card represents an operator-triggered cleanup action, not a persistent default state.

windows_defaults.notes: Use detection and operator intent rather than assuming a fixed baseline.
